content: {"doneWhen":{"path":"player","op":"at","x":11,"y":1},"modes":[{"id":"flee","priority":20,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest_monster_distance","op":"lte","value":2},{"path":"health","op":"lt","value":50}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"flee-monsters"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"always","op":"eq","value":true}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"reach-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"reach-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const r = await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk failed '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } } const body = await b.body(); b.log('at '+body.x+','+body.y); }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'pos '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"},{"name":"flee-monsters","skill":"async (b) => { const body = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); let best = null; let bestD = 1e9; for (const m of ms) { const d = Math.abs(m.x-body.x)+Math.abs(m.y-body.y); if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = m; } } if (!best) return; const dx = body.x - best.x; const dy = body.y - best.y; let tx = body.x; let ty = body.y; if (Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy)) { tx = body.x + (dx >= 0 ? 1 : -1); } else { ty = body.y + (dy >= 0 ? 1 : -1); } tx = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, tx)); ty = Math.max(0, Math.min(9, ty)); await b.walkTo(tx, ty, 'stand'); }","check":"async (b) => { const body = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); for (const m of ms) { if (Math.abs(m.x-body.x)+Math.abs(m.y-body.y) <= 2) return {ok:false, detail:'monster near'}; } return {ok:true, detail:'safe'}; }"}]}
